supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Moderate lateral extension visible beyond the ocular margins.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Muzzle region displays higher pixel intensity (lighter grey) compared to the lower intensity (darker) periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Medium 2D vertical thickness with a neutral, non-drooping posture.

pinna_silhouette.outer_helix_geometry: Rounded apex with slight irregular contouring along the posterior helix.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-contrast white/grey hair across the chin and lower muzzle area.
